name: pbc
description: Control a persistent logged-in Chrome profile with the PBC command-line tool.

interface.longDescription: Use PBC to inspect and automate a persistent Chrome profile through snapshots, stable element references, clicks, forms, uploads, downloads, screenshots, JavaScript evaluation, and tab management. The local PBC CLI is required.
capabilities: Accessible page snapshots and stable refs
Form, upload, download, and tab control
interface.defaultPrompt: Use PBC to inspect and interact with my current Chrome page.
